  "summary": "The complaint describes an intermittent wiring short that interrupted high-voltage battery coolant pump operation; the dealership reportedly restored operation by repairing the wiring. None of the candidate recalls addresses this failure, and the earlier complaints returned do not establish a matching pattern.
